title: Grand Ceremony Held at AWKUM Under Prime Minister’s Laptop Distribution Program
text:
A grand
ceremony was organized under the Prime Minister’s Laptop Distribution Program
at Abdul Wali Khan University, Mardan (AWKUM), in which Federal Minister
Engineer Amir Muqam attended as the special guest.

Addressing the
ceremony, Vice Chancellor Professor Dr. Jamil Ahmed stated that the laptop
scheme is a significant initiative aimed at equipping youth with modern
technology and enhancing their educational and research capabilities. He
informed the audience that 900 laptops will be distributed among deserving
students of Abdul Wali Khan University, Mardan, under the program.

In his address,
the special guest Engineer Amir Muqam emphasized that students are the future
of the nation, and investing in them is a guarantee of a bright and prosperous
future for the country. He highlighted that the government is giving special
priority to the education and technology sectors to empower the youth and
prepare them for contemporary challenges.

The ceremony
was attended by a large number of university administrators, faculty members,
officers, and students, reflecting the enthusiasm and importance of the
initiative.
